Five tasks needed local programs. Tower of Hanoi used direct model decisions.

The main unresolved failure is short instruction handoff.

Stroop missed all three attention checks; memory missed six of ten. A local policy can keep responding while the agent is delayed, but novel instructions may expire before an agent answer arrives. Stroop and visual search also produced 19 ms median response times. These runs demonstrate operation, not human timing or behavior.

What the evidence does not establish

  • Unseen-task generalization, audio support, human behavioral validity, or timing equivalence.
  • Direct per-word model comprehension in the OCR reading run.
  • Remote data acceptance: stop-signal and memory uploads failed; Stroop and visual-search acknowledgment was unconfirmed.
  • Isolated policy generation: authoring inherited agent context; full generation/tool transcripts were unavailable.

Validation: 772 tests passed, 6 skipped, with seven existing AsyncMock warnings. Skill metadata and documentation links passed. The optional OCR helper matched 13/14 glyphs exactly and 14/14 ignoring case; the ambiguity remains disclosed.

Design follows the repository’s existing architecture review: DaisyUI/Tailwind, system typography, restrained status colors. This local report embeds its evidence downloads; it does not publish data.
